issues.reason: Thematic roles puts an intransitive subject of an internal change of state (stall, weaken, sag, fade; collapse, melt, spread) in Patient and defines Theme as an object with no change to it, so (Theme sk_shrink_1 sk_crowd_1) mis-types a crowd that does change; the Scalar-change-subject-is-Theme carve-out does not reach it, since no figure is stated and the subject is an entity rather than a value-bearing dimension.

Leaving threads on the lanterns displaces them without creating, destroying, consuming or physically changing them, so the direct-object test of Thematic roles ("does the object itself change?", and when unclear default to Theme) licenses Theme, and (Patient sk_leave_1 sk_thread_1) asserts an alteration the sentence does not state.
The crowd_leave_rule conclusion repeats the same mis-typed role as (Patient (sk_leave $x) sk_thread_1), so every per-member event the rule mints inherits the defect.

new_gaps: Ordinal day-of-year date in a non-Gregorian calendar ("On day 630 of Year 2"): the Time section's structured terms assume (Day n) is a day-of-month sitting under a (Month ...), so a day index of 630 has no licensed slot and is stored indistinguishably from a day-of-month reading. A licensed form would need to carry the calendar system (or an explicit day-of-year term) alongside the year.
defect_summary: Issue 0's compliant form is (Patient sk_shrink_1 sk_crowd_1), the intransitive change-of-state subject role. Issue 1's is (Theme sk_leave_1 sk_thread_1), the displaced-not-altered object role. Issue 2's is the same swap inside the rule conclusion, (Theme (sk_leave $x) sk_thread_1); all three have licensed forms, so no gap follows from them.
notes: The reviewer's own note on (Possession sk_keeper_1 east_row) is well-founded — Complements of nouns and adjectives bars Possession for an argument and "keeper of the East Row" paraphrases as "one who keeps the East Row", making (Of sk_keeper_1 east_row) the licensed form — but it was filed as a note, not an issue, so it is not adjudicated here. Also unraised: (Location sk_hunt_1 east_row) moves the crowd-modifying "at the East Row" onto the hunting event.
